messages:
ashley: Heads up - eu-west3 nodepool showing a sudden local writeback surge, GPUs failing to attach. Noticed after yesterday's kernel backport.

ops-bot: [ALERT] nvme_writeback_pressure on gnode-eu3-114 - io_target_utilization=85% - auto-handoff triggered

kyle: Seeing a flood of tiny random writes now, write amplification looks high. IOPS on /dev/nvme0n1 jumped from ~20k to ~100k write_ops. Attach queue backs up.

neha: Any janitor/cleanup jobs running right now? If scrub + snapshot overlapped we'd see exactly this.

ashley: Confirmed - cleaner cron aligned with snapshot bulk job at 03:00 UTC. Also the backport adjusted vm.dirty_ratio defaults slightly upward. :grimacing:

kyle: Quick mitigation we can do without reboots: lower dirty_ratio and enable io-smoothing fallback on affected nodes. Command I ran on the canary node:
```
sudo sysctl -w vm.dirty_ratio=5 vm.dirty_background_ratio=2
# enable runtime adaptive fallback flag (one-off): sudo /usr/local/bin/rwctl runtime set io_smoothing=adaptive_fallback
```

sam: I pushed a runtime config snippet to the canary group as well: `/etc/redwood/runtime.conf` -> `io_smoothing=adaptive_fallback`. Rolling it via canary so we don't impact other regions. :rocket:

neha: Canary rollout started? I'll hold janitor window change until we confirm.

ashley: Canary started for gnode-eu3-{112,113,114} at ts=3251234590. Monitoring attach_wait and write_iops.

deploybot: Deploybot: canary-update applied to gnode-eu3-112, gnode-eu3-113, gnode-eu3-114 at 3251234590

kyle: Early metrics look promising — attach_wait down from ~120s -> ~30s on canary, write_iops down ~40%. NVMe queue depth also reduced.

ashley: Plan: keep canary for 30m then roll rest of eu-west3. Move janitor snapshot window +1h to avoid overlap.

sam: Quick cost callout — adaptive_fallback disables some aggressive batching/kv-cache optimizations; expect ~7% inference token cost increase while enabled. Noted for finance heads. :warning:

neha: I'll file a short postmortem with action items: revert kernel backport defaults, add probe for vm.dirty_ratio drift, and add scheduling guard so janitor/snapshot windows don't overlap. For now proceed with rollout.

ashley: Thanks team. Keep alerts up and ping here if any regressions.
